_about: Learned layer. Written by Gate answers and `rot.py learn` (artifact syncs). Overrides patch curated achievements; ingest turns every text change into an append-only supersession in resume.db. Never delete entries — retire them.

variants.change: Ran a diagnostic, discovery-first approach — mapping stakeholders and how an organization operates before proposing anything that changes it.

variants.ops: Added ~125 net-new qualified accounts weekly in Salesforce, ZoomInfo, and Sales Navigator while maintaining pipeline stage and forecast discipline.

psp-full-cycle-ownership.canonical: Owned the full sales cycle in a pure new-business role — prospecting, discovery, pricing, proposal, negotiation, and close — with no SDR layer.

variants.player-coach: Carried an individual revenue target on a self-built book, running full-cycle discovery, proposal, negotiation, and close.

variants.media: Sold integrated print and digital as one buy — benchmarked 77–78% print recall vs. 44–46% digital and priced the placement against category CPA.

variants.generic: Built the business case the champion defends without the seller present — authored a board memo written as the client's own document.

psp-verticals.canonical: Sold across automotive, retail, hospitality, building products, commercial fleet, and property management, qualifying each against the budget that funds it.

variants.weather: Sold into weather-exposed categories — automotive, building products, fleet, property management, regional retail — where purchase timing is condition-driven.

variants.services: Cut a proposed $950K/year, five-person engineering build to roughly a quarter of the cost without cutting the core deliverable.

baseline_overrides.summary: Revenue and go-to-market operator with eight years of full-cycle B2B, media, and enterprise technology sales, currently advising the CEO and board of an AI start-up on go-to-market, pricing, and buy-vs-build strategy. Wins net-new business from cold — Fortune 500 accounts at TEKsystems, NFL and MLB team partnerships at Professional Sports Publications — by qualifying on the budget that can actually fund a buy and building the CPM, CPA, and unit-economics case a client's finance team can defend. Has led a team of up to five, coaching performance against daily process and 1:1 metrics, and uses Claude and OpenAI models daily to compress research, account mapping, and proposal cycles.
